text:
sam: starting config-only deploy to tighten per-tenant rate limits + shorten batching window. change window 14:00-15:00 UTC. pushing config v2.1.3 (limits, timeouts, routing). deploybot: triggered canary rollout to 5% of traffic.
deploybot: canary started at 1785056792 — monitoring metrics: p95 latency, error-rate, queue-length. will report.
maya: can we hold for 10m? customer demo at 14:10 UTC for tenant `acme-inc`.
sam: noted. holding initial ramp 5 -> 10% until 14:05 — will skip 20% bump.
kevin: suggest pin heavy tenants to dedicated routing class during canary to avoid noisy neighbors. code: `routing_policy: { "pin_tenants": ["acme-inc"], "class": "dedicated" }`
jen: ensure rollback playbook ready. if p95 increases > 30% or errors > 0.5% we abort and roll back to v2.1.2. who owns the rollback?
luis: ops-oncall will coordinate rollback. recommend staged rollback: unroute canary traffic, then revert config, then clear KV cache warmup.
ops-oncall: ack. I’ll watch tail latency and KV cache pressure. set alert thresholds: `tail_latency_p95 > 500ms` or `kvcache_evictions_per_min > 50`.
sam: adding a temporary metric dashboard link and release notes: https://redwood/release-notes/v2.1.3 (notes include batching_window 8ms -> 4ms, per_tenant_limit 1200 -> 900, timeout 30s -> 20s).
maya: also FYI — demo tenant was flagged earlier for high retry rates. keep them on dedicated routing. :eyes:
deploybot: canary at 5% stable for 3m. p95 baseline 180ms -> canary 190ms (within 10%). errors zero.
kevin: can we reduce `batch_max_tokens` from 2048 to 1536 for the canary group to lower kv pressure?
sam: applied to canary only. snippet: ```json
{"batching": {"max_tokens": 1536, "window_ms": 4}, "limits": {"per_tenant_qps": 900}, "timeouts": {"request_timeout_ms": 20000}}
```
jen: good. once canary holds for 10m, stage to 20% with same pinned tenants.
luis: reminder — keep previous config pinned for 24h to enable quick rollback. add tag `rollback: v2.1.2` on route.
ops-oncall: I’ll add ephemeral alerts and set a pager if p95 crosses threshold for more than 2 consecutive minutes.
maya: thumbs up from product for the demo path. :thumbsup:
sam: rolling to 20% at 14:12 UTC per plan. will post status updates. if anyone wants to abort, say now.
deploybot: ramp to 20% started at 1785056822.
deploybot: ramp steady. canary metrics snapshot: p95 195ms, errors 0.02%, kvcache_evictions 12/min.
kevin: looks fine. proceed to gradual 50% over next 20m if stable.
jen: remember release note blurb for customer-facing changelog: short note on reduced batching_window and tightened per-tenant limits with rollback window.
sam: noted. final check: no objections -> proceeding. :thumbsup:
maya: no objections from my side. monitoring closely.
ops-oncall: standing by. will escalate if thresholds breached.
deploybot: rollout to 50% scheduled at 1785056880 (on hold until 14:30 UTC manual go).
sam: end of thread — will update when 50% go/no-go decision made.
